The '''WorldArmor 4 Defensive Shield''' was a common type of [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] system used to protect military compounds and fortresses. It required a crew of twenty-five to operate. Six of these generators were employed by [[Fortress Keremark]] to deflect orbital bombardments and drew their power from the fortress' main and secondary power generators.<ref name="HS" />
